about:
Atlantic Poly Inc is headquartered in Norwood, Massachusetts, and was founded in 1981. The company operates as a New England–based polyethylene supplier and national wholesale distributor of plastic bags, films, and packaging products.

The product line encompasses a broad range of polyethylene and specialty bags, including custom printed bags, gusseted bags, high-density bags, recycled-content bags, anti-static bags, mil-spec bags, clean-room ISO-certified bags, stretch film, bubble wrap, pallet covers, zip-lock bags, shrink bags, construction film, dry-cleaning bags, grocery bags, heat-seal systems, poly tubing, and water-soluble bags. The company offers customization services such as printing, gusseting, side welding, bottom sealing, perforating, wicketing, and co-extrusion. It serves both small and large orders with no stated minimum order quantity and maintains a customer service team whose representatives each have at least 15 years of packaging industry experience. Atlantic Poly also leverages a network of other manufacturers to source items it does not produce in-house.

Customers span medical device packaging (including Aclar bags for long-term storage), electronics manufacturing (anti-static nylon bags), military and defense (mil-spec packaging), construction (vapor barrier films), retail (grocery and shopping bags), dry cleaning, industrial packaging, and clean-room environments.

The company promotes an “Eco-Green” seal, highlighting recycled and biodegradable bag options to help clients meet environmental standards. It positions itself as a poly bag expert specializing in customization and relies on its supplier network to fulfill requirements beyond its own production capabilities.
